title: Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern generative models produce high-quality individual outputs but struggle to sample diversely, even when explicitly instructed to do so. We introduce MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER (MSR), a test-time approach that externalizes the diversity into an explicit, corpus-derived sampling procedure. Our pipeline (i) mines an interpretable categorical schema from a corpus of real artifacts and supplies statistics for sampling; (ii) samples attribute configurations from the corpus-derived statistics; (iii) uses a generative model purely as a conditional renderer of a sampled configuration. Across weather report generation, user simulation, webpage design, text-to-image generation, and agent-generated 3D assets, we evaluate the diversity and output quality of MSR-guided generation and show that MSR improves alignment with corpus distributions and diversity of generated outputs.

translated_title: 挖掘、采样、渲染：生成模型的测试时多样性对齐
translated_abstract: 现代生成模型能够产生高质量的单独输出，但难以实现多样化采样，即使被明确要求这样做也是如此。我们提出了 MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER（MSR），这是一种测试时方法，将多样性外化为一个显式的、由语料库导出的采样过程。我们的流程（i）从真实制品的语料库中挖掘出可解释的类别模式，并提供用于采样的统计数据；（ii）根据语料库导出的统计数据采样属性配置；（iii）将生成模型纯粹用作已采样配置的条件渲染器。在天气报告生成、用户模拟、网页设计、文生图以及智能体生成的3D资产等任务上，我们评估了 MSR 引导生成的多样性和输出质量，结果表明 MSR 改善了生成输出与语料库分布的对齐程度以及生成输出的多样性。
tldr: 提出 MSR 测试时框架，通过从真实语料库挖掘类别模式并采样属性配置，将生成模型仅作为条件渲染器，从而显著提升生成输出的多样性与语料库分布的对齐度。
en_tdlr: MSR is a test-time framework that mines interpretable categorical schemas from real corpora and samples attribute configurations, using generative models purely as conditional renderers to significantly improve output diversity and alignment with corpus distributions.
